title: Normalized derived tensor descent with abstract coefficient categories
statement: For a symmetric monoidal closed Grothendieck abelian coefficient category B with functorial flat resolutions, a scheme T and a target complex category H, let F be a complex realization and LF its derived realization, with an exact localization factor isomorphism. A specified K-flat source representative class P, its preservation in a specified target resolving class, fully faithful resolving restriction, a signed-total tensor comparison, and a target tensor model determine a unique representative-normalized derived tensor isomorphism. Its actual normalization equation is proved in curried notation. The fixed source localization tensor identification is the inverse localization tensorator [lem-sf-finite-scalar-tensor-resolution]; the generic descent is [lem-weil-pbc-tensor-comparison-descent-representatives].

proof.text: Invert the source localization tensorator on the K-flat class using the proved fixed representative API, keeping the coefficient category abstract. Use the supplied intrinsic model representative and signed-total comparison. Preserve the published source abelian and localization category data.

Apply tensorComparisonDescent, which gives existence and uniqueness with the actual representative equation. Choose this uniquely determined isomorphism, curry it, and prove that currying leaves its components unchanged.
